investment_strategy: Core-satellite AI strategy sized for a constructive-but-volatile market. Anchor the portfolio in lower-volatility, high-quality AI platform compounders with robust cash flows and positive analyst consensus (Microsoft, Alphabet), and add a smaller, high-beta AI compute leader (NVIDIA) for upside. Elevated VIX (~23) and a 4.28% 10Y warrant conservative risk sizing, tighter position limits on high-vol names, and focus on firms with earnings resilience, strong ROE, and clear AI monetization paths. Monitor hyperscaler AI capex cadence, antitrust outcomes, export-control headlines, and data-center power constraints. Rebalance quarterly or on 15–20% position drifts; add on pullbacks tied to transient news rather than structural changes.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Screened for lower volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, high ROE, reasonable leverage, and strong analyst consensus; weighted by quality, momentum, and macro risk (VIX, 10Y).
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive but choppy: AI-driven multi-year demand and CHIPS/onshoring support semis and hyperscalers, while tighter financial conditions, antitrust actions, and export controls elevate risk premia. Favor quality platforms with clear AI ROI and maintain disciplined sizing in high-beta beneficiaries.
